# Cortex — Operations Overview

Live operational dashboard for the **cortexks** stack. Data sources:
- **Application Insights** (`cortexks-ai`) — requests, traces, custom metrics emitted by the FastAPI backend.
- **Container App** (`cortexks-api`) — replica restart count metric.

Custom metric reference: `cortex.rag.cost_usd_estimate` is emitted per `/api/ai/answer` call by the RAG pipeline (see PR beta / Round 20).

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| where name == "cortex.rag.cost_usd_estimate"
| summarize cost_usd = sum(value)
content.title: Total RAG cost — last 24h

content.json:
## 🔝 Top 10 costliest queries (last 24h)

Grouped by `route` + `model` from the `customDimensions` of `cortex.rag.cost_usd_estimate`.

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| where name == "cortex.rag.cost_usd_estimate"
| extend route = tostring(customDimensions.route), model = tostring(customDimensions.model)
| summarize total_cost_usd = sum(value), call_count = count() by route, model
| order by total_cost_usd desc
| take 10
content.title: Top 10 costliest (route, model) pairs

content.json:
## 🚨 Error rate per route (last 6h)

5xx-or-greater responses as a percentage of total requests, grouped by route name.

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp > ago(6h)
| summarize total = count(), errors = countif(toint(resultCode) >= 500) by name
| extend error_rate_pct = round(100.0 * errors / total, 2)
| order by error_rate_pct desc
content.title: 5xx error rate by route — last 6h

content.json:
## ⏱️ p95 latency per route (last 6h)

Top 20 routes by call count. p50 and p95 of `requests.duration` in milliseconds.

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp > ago(6h)
| summarize p95_ms = percentile(duration, 95), p50_ms = percentile(duration, 50), call_count = count() by name
| order by call_count desc
| take 20
content.title: p50 / p95 latency by route — last 6h

content.json:
## 🔁 Replica restart count (last 24h)

Container App replica restart count over the last 24 hours. Spikes indicate liveness-probe failures or OOMs.

*Note:* this tile expects the workbook to be opened with the Container App resource selected as a secondary scope, OR the resource pinned via the parameter below.

content.query:
InsightsMetrics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where Name == "RestartCount"
| summarize restarts = max(Val) by bin(TimeGenerated, 30m)
| render timechart
content.title: Replica restart count — last 24h
